tasks.title: Implement MergeQueue class with enqueue, processNext, retry, and build verification
tasks.spec: specs/merge-queue/spec.md#requirement-mergequeue-串行处理-issue-合并, specs/merge-build-verification/spec.md#requirement-合并后执行构建验证
tasks.description: Create packages/cli/src/git/merge-queue.ts with a MergeQueue class. The class manages an in-memory queue (Map<issueNumber, MergeEntry>). Implement enqueue(projectId, issueNumber) that adds to queue, sets mergeState=pending, emits merge_queued, and triggers processNext if idle. Implement processNext() that picks next pending entry, sets mergeState=merging, calls worktreeManager.mergeBack(), then runs npm run build (5min timeout), on success calls worktreeManager.remove() and sets mergeState=merged, on build failure runs git reset --hard HEAD~1 and sets mergeState=build-failed. On conflict sets mergeState=conflict. Always emits appropriate events and continues to next item. Implement retry(issueNumber) that re-enqueues failed entries. Implement getStatus() returning all entries. Implement recoverFromDB() that scans issues with merge_state IN ('pending','merging') and re-enqueues them.
acceptanceCriteria: MergeQueue.enqueue() adds issue to queue, sets mergeState=pending, emits merge_queued
Duplicate enqueue is idempotent (logs warning, does not re-add)
Queue processes entries serially — only one merge at a time
Successful merge + build pass: worktree cleaned up, mergeState=merged, merge_completed emitted
Merge conflict: worktree preserved, mergeState=conflict, merge_failed emitted with reason='conflict'
Build failure: git reset --hard HEAD~1 executed, worktree preserved, mergeState=build-failed, merge_failed emitted with reason='build-failed'
Build timeout (5min): process killed, git reset executed, mergeState=build-failed
retry() works for build-failed and conflict states, rejects other states
getStatus() returns sorted entries with { issueNumber, projectId, mergeState, message?, enqueuedAt }
recoverFromDB() re-enqueues pending entries and resets merging→pending
Typecheck passes: cd packages/cli && npx tsc --noEmit
tasks.notes: MergeQueue constructor receives: WorktreeManager, IssueRepo, ProjectService, EventBus.

tasks.title: Add merge-queue status and retry-merge API endpoints
tasks.spec: specs/http-api/spec.md#requirement-api-提供合并队列状态查询端点
tasks.description: Add two new endpoints in api/issues.ts (inside createIssueRoutes): GET /merge-queue/status returns mergeQueue.getStatus() for current project (400 if no project).
